These are the videos created by [[Rockstar San Diego]] during the pre-release time period before [[Red Dead Redemption]]. On February 3, 2009, [[Rockstar Games]] announced the first official trailer. Resulting trailers showcased numerous characters, gameplay features, and [[multiplayer]] modes that will be featured in the final release.
